Long low streamlined body, a flat wedge shaped head, a small fierce eye, a tall blade shaped dorsal fin, a row of long hollow bone spines along its back with red tips, a heavy tail with a sickle shaped fin. Smooth scales, dusty brick red back with darker scars from old hunts, pale sand belly. Menacing, real shark proportions, gritty detailed 32-bit arcade boss sprite. Clean dark outline, crisp shading with few colours. The whole body inside the image with clear margins. One creature only. Plain flat uniform blue grey (#56616c) background, no floor, no sand, no water, no text.
